summary: Cancel a Node interval Timeout handle, including cross-compatible timeout handles, and return undefined.

target.notes: Cancel the shared Timeout-handle scheduling state and return undefined.

semantics.accepted_handle: Timeout from setInterval or setTimeout; same-thread primitive token is also accepted
semantics.cross_api: can cancel a one-shot Timeout handle

caveats: Node Timeout handles back both setTimeout and setInterval; do not enforce a C# type split that rejects cross-clear usage.

tests.name: stops repeated callbacks
tests.expected_behavior: prints true and no later interval callbacks occur
